title: Local report retention cleanup
responsibility: Removes old nonreserved files and untracked run contents while preserving known runs and symlinks.

inputs.name: reportLocalCleanup.root
inputs.description: Report store root, which must not itself be a symlink.

inputs.name: reportLocalCleanup.cutoff
inputs.description: Finite modification-time cutoff in epoch milliseconds; files at or before it are eligible.

inputs.name: reportLocalCleanup.dryRun
inputs.description: Optional dry-run flag, defaulting to false. True counts eligible files without deleting them.

inputs.name: reportLocalCleanup.knownRuns
inputs.description: Optional set of known run identifiers, defaulting to empty; known run directories are skipped.

outputs.name: reportLocalCleanup
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the number of eligible files removed or counted. Skips root dot entries and reserved metadata, traverses other directories and orphan runs, skips symlinks and removes empty old directories during a real cleanup.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects a nonfinite cutoff or symlinked root/runs directory. Filesystem inspection and deletion errors propagate.
